problem:
$$
P=[\begin{aligned}0.35 & 0.3 \\ 0.65 & 0.7\end{aligned}],\,{x}_{0}=[\begin{aligned}0.5 \\ 0.5\end{aligned}]
$$

Consider a Markov chain with the stochastic matrix $P$ and the initial state vector ${x}_{0}$ given above. Calculate the state vector ${x}_{1}.$
worked_solution:
To find the state vector ${x}_{1},$ we apply one step of the Markov chain:

$$
{x}_{1}=P{x}_{0}
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} & =P{x}_{0} \\  & =[\begin{aligned}0.35 & 0.3 \\ 0.65 & 0.7\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}0.5 \\ 0.5\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}0.325 \\ 0.675\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
